newsitem.title: USA: Conrail rejects Norfolk Southern bid.
newsitem.headline: Conrail rejects Norfolk Southern bid.

text.p: Conrail Inc said it was recommending that shareholders not tender their shares to Norfolk Southern Corp, which has offered to buy the railroad for $10 billion.
Instead, Conrail and CSX reaffirmed their $8.5 billion merger agreement and said they have been discussing increasing the value of the pact upon consummation of the transaction.
Conrail and CSX noted that there could be no assurances that their pact would be modified.

It was the second time that Conrail rejected an offer from Norfolk Southern in favor of its planned union with CSX. Conrail has repeatedly said that the CSX transaction provides more strategic benefits.
Shares of Conrail rose Tuesday on views that CSX might might sweeten terms of the deal in order to narrow the gap between its proposal and the Norfolk Southern bid.
